svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 16-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 12.3 s, bun check 37.0 s, tsgo 81.7 s. Peak memory: tsrs 12.6 GiB, bun check 15.3 GiB, tsgo 53.1 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 2.20 s, 1.80 GiB; bun check 4.47 s, 1.51 GiB; tsgo 10.96 s, 7.50 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.15 s, 0.25 GiB; bun check 0.30 s, 0.30 GiB; tsgo 0.80 s, 0.73 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.29 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.56 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.45 s, 1.15 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 1.02 s, 1.05 GiB; bun check 9.50 s, 5.30 GiB; tsgo 12.18 s, 7.52 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.07 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.11 s, 0.12 GiB; tsgo 0.30 s, 0.21 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.09 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.20 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.53 s, 0.23 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 1.02 s, 1.14 GiB; bun check 3.07 s, 0.92 GiB; tsgo 5.92 s, 4.29 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 1.20 s, 1.45 GiB; bun check 2.54 s, 1.33 GiB; tsgo 6.99 s, 5.64 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 1.19 s, 1.18 GiB; bun check 3.58 s, 0.89 GiB; tsgo 7.00 s, 4.81 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 1.68 s, 1.18 GiB; bun check 3.74 s, 1.02 GiB; tsgo 14.72 s, 6.19 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 1.61 s, 1.39 GiB; bun check 4.97 s, 0.76 GiB; tsgo 10.32 s, 6.39 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.45 s, 0.55 GiB; bun check 0.95 s, 0.50 GiB; tsgo 3.10 s, 1.79 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.30 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.63 s, 0.42 GiB; tsgo 1.57 s, 1.30 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.26 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.53 s, 0.45 GiB; tsgo 1.67 s, 1.37 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.25 s, 0.38 GiB; bun check 0.71 s, 0.41 GiB; tsgo 1.30 s, 1.15 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.21 s, 0.34 GiB; bun check 0.43 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.13 s, 1.05 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.27 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 0.76 s, 0.53 GiB; tsgo 1.79 s, 1.74 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-16 06:33 UTC; tsrs commit 1cdee41349ad08492e29c401fafbdfd6e8a889f8. TypeScript 7.0.2; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
